title: Predicting protein electrostatics with protein language models

key_results: RKEC1 forms compact ligand-bound structure lacking Watson-Crick duplex or G-quadruplex core; structure explains dopamine specificity among structural analogues

hypotheses.hypothesis: DNA aptamers adopt unconventional folds distinct from predicted Watson-Crick or G-quadruplex architectures

hypotheses.hypothesis: Atomic structural details explain dopamine selectivity
hypotheses.result: Confirmed: structure-guided biosensor design and specificity explanation for dopamine vs. analogues
